summary: Iteration 2 testing: 21/21 backend pytest tests pass (12 regression + 9 new features). Full Playwright E2E of new features passes: cookie consent banner (accept + persistence + reload), 3 legal pages (privacidad/terminos/cookies) with legal-title + header/footer, 2-step reservation wizard (people stepper with 1-40 bounds, date/time gating on Continuar, back button, success), song request modal on /catalogo (HTML5 validation blocks empty email, valid submission returns success, localStorage okume-guest-email stored), admin login, overview page with all 6 stat cards including clients=8 and requestsToday=3, sidebar links Clientes/Cola de canciones present, clients page renders 8 contacts, campaign composer submits, queue page pending/played columns render, toggle->played + undo + delete + date filter all work. End-to-end confirmed: song requests and reservation emails posted from the public site appear in admin Clientes and admin Cola de canciones today's queue.

ui_bugs.issue: Review spec expects data-testid='reservation-phone-input' but code uses 'reservation-contact-input'. Not a functional bug (form works) but breaks the contract stated in the review request.

action_items: Optional: rename data-testid 'reservation-contact-input' -> 'reservation-phone-input' to match the review spec, or update the spec.

Optional (dev-only): suppress benign ResizeObserver 'loop completed with undelivered notifications' warning so CRA's dev-only error overlay does not intrusively appear when transitioning wizard steps. Not a production issue.
critical_code_review_comments: publicRoutes.js and adminRoutes.js correctly clone documents before insertOne to avoid _id mutation leaking into responses (regression from iteration 1 is fixed).
Cron follow-up correctly ACKs 202 immediately and executes work in setImmediate; uses timingSafeEqual on Bearer secret (good).
Song request dateKey uses Europe/Madrid Intl formatting so 'today' matches admin queue filter reliably.
sendCampaignEmail loop is sequential (await inside for). For large client lists this will be slow; consider Promise.allSettled with a concurrency cap.
Consider validating req.query.date on the client with a min bound (currently allowed to query any valid YYYY-MM-DD).
test_credentials: admin@okumekaraoke.com / OkumeAdmin2026! (from review request; /app/memory/test_credentials.md was empty/missing)
seed_data_creation: Test-only data created and cleaned: TEST reservations, TEST song requests, TEST clients (all deleted via admin DELETE endpoints inside pytest). Playwright flows left a few 'test_ui_*@example.com' entries in the DB that are visible in admin Clientes/Reservas but are safe to ignore or delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new-feature endpoints and UI flows validated end-to-end. Backend tests split into test_okume_api_regression.py (existing flows) and test_okume_new_features.py (iteration 2). Note: /api/admin/campaigns takes ~10-20s with current client count because sendCampaignEmail iterates sequentially and Resend rejects most addresses (only greciaashford@gmail.com would deliver) - this is expected. When testing wizard/song-request UI, the CRA dev overlay for a ResizeObserver warning can intercept clicks; suppressing it via add_init_script (see script comments) resolves the issue.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Only spec/implementation naming mismatch: review requested 'reservation-phone-input' testid, implementation uses 'reservation-contact-input'. Trivial to align on either side.
